referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Estimation of infrastructure from wet-phosphoric acid production plant including building materials and material for processing equipment. Transport of materials to construction site. Dismaterling of plant and disposal. Land useand occupation for plant.

geography.text: Estimated data refers on a plant built in Jordania. Land use considered from a large plant in Florida. Land use asessed and extrapoleated with data of a mayor site in Florida.

technology.text: Estimated. No specific technology modelled. Tranport requirement of steel cylinder included.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Estimation of the infrastructure will have low representativity because they were asessed with data from a small scale plant.
